criteria.description: Primary mega disclosure and mobile toggle reach closed, open, navigation-open, and nested-open states via selector-driven interactions
Exactly one primary links tree (#rbm-primary-links / ul.ren-nav-links) serves desktop and mobile
Exactly one visible mega chevron (.rbm-chevron); classless summary::after must be neutralized
Open panel exposes eight destinations with icons, titles, and visible descriptions plus two featured articles
Solutions summary shares the centerY axis with peer primary links (Product, Pricing) within 2px
Mobile primary rows are full-width and start-aligned without nested-card details chrome
Desktop panel sits under the bar; mobile panel stays in-flow; no horizontal overflow
Summary opens by click/Enter/Space; Escape closes and restores focus to SUMMARY
With JavaScript disabled on mobile, the single tree and native disclosure destinations remain usable
Visible interactive targets inside [data-rbm-root] meet 44×44 in a touch context
prefers-reduced-motion disables block-local transitions and animations on panel/chevron/dest/feature
Mega menu preview passes axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA
Light and dark surfaces resolve through RenDS semantic tokens
Navigation suite adopts expectSingleVisibleAffordance, expectAligned, expectWidthRatio, expectNoOverflow, and inspectNativeChrome without dropping block-specific assertions
render-matrix.json declares exactly 10 states with selector actions and expectedMarkers; capture runner writes 10 PNG + 10 JSON under ignored .ren10-workflow/captures/navbar5/
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief and cascade map
